# ABOUT THIS SITE
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

> GRC Engineered is the personal website and technical blog of Zeshan Ahmad, a
> GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Specialist and AI Governance practitioner
> based in India. The site is intended for recruiters, hiring managers, and
> cybersecurity professionals looking for expert insights on GRC engineering,
> AI governance, and cloud risk management.

## About Zeshan Ahmad

Zeshan Ahmad is a GRC Specialist currently employed at Cisco (Splunk) as of September 2023,
working remotely. He has over 7 years of professional experience in GRC and information
security, with prior roles at Deloitte India, TIAA, and TVS Motor Company.

**Certifications:**
- CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) — ISACA
- CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) — ISACA
- ISO 42001 Lead Auditor — TÜV SÜD (AI Management Systems)
- ISO 27001 Lead Auditor — TÜV SÜD (Information Security)
- NSD Certified Penetration Tester
- Securing DevSecOps

**Education:**
- MBA in Business Analytics — Liverpool Business School (2023–2025)
- B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering — KIIT University (2014–2018)

**Areas of expertise:**
- AI governance and ISO 42001 implementation
- Cloud risk management and CSPM (Wiz, ScoutSuite)
- GRC automation using AWS SSM, OPA/Rego, Terraform, Splunk
- SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0, FAIR risk frameworks
- Third-party risk management (TPRM)
- Policy-as-code and compliance pipeline engineering

**Notable work:**
- Founded OWASP Ranchi Chapter
- Technical reviewer for a published CISM preparation book (Hemang Doshi)
- Led ISO 42001 AI governance program at Cisco Splunk
- Designed automated compliance evidence pipeline with AWS SSM + Splunk

**Open to:** Senior GRC, AI Governance, and Cloud Risk roles at globally distributed,
remote-first organizations.

**Contact:** LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/zeshan-ahmad

## Blog Posts

- [ISO 42001 in Practice](https://zeshan-ahmad.github.io/blog/posts/iso-42001-practical-guide.html): Practitioner guide to implementing ISO 42001 AI governance — scope, risk assessment, Annex A controls, audit readiness
- [Automating Compliance Evidence with AWS SSM and Splunk](https://zeshan-ahmad.github.io/blog/posts/grc-automation-aws-ssm.html): Building automated SOC 2 evidence pipelines using AWS Systems Manager, Lambda, and Splunk
- [CSPM Is Not a Product](https://zeshan-ahmad.github.io/blog/posts/cloud-risk-cspm-wiz.html): How to build the governance practice around CSPM tools like Wiz and ScoutSuite
